Title: Re: Dam the heart's river and Dagon's call

Messages.Author: Pendargon
Messages.Body:
just to check if i am right, but when a minion plays in combat Dam the heart's river, followed by a Dagon's call (providing opposing minion did not dodge or combat end), opposing minion would take 2 unpreventable damage during the press step, right?

Dam the Heart's River
Combat
Quietus
Frenzy. Only usable before range is determined. A vampire can play only one Dam the Heart's River each combat.
[qui] This combat, each strike or damaging effect made against the opposing minion inflicts +1 damage.
[QUI] As above, and this combat, strikes cost the opposing minion 1 additional blood or life, and the opposing minion can choose not to strike.

Dagon`s Call, Combat, 1 blood, Quietus
qui] Strike: make a hand strike (at strength damage) and the opposing minion takes 1 unpreventable damage during the press step each round this combat. A vampire may play only one Dagon`s Call each combat.
[QUI] As above, and this hand strike does strength+1 damage.

> Blooded wrote:
> Edit: Even better, dam + outside + catatonic for 4 dmg and sce as well
>
Catatonic Fear's damage isn't "boosted" by Dam the Heart's River, as it isn't inflicted "this combat", but "once this combat ends" (== "after combat ends").
So, your math is correct 2 (OtH) + 1 (DtHB) + 1 (CF) = 4 damage - but not 4+1(DtHB).

EDIT Ankha 2020-08-04: This ruling has a REVERSAL, see: www.vekn.net/forum/rules-questions/72635-dam-the-heart-s-river-and-catatonic-fear?start=0#72638

> Borrelstein wrote:

General Rulings, Damage : Adding damage to strikes which are not damage dealing strikes will not deal damage (e.g., using Lucky Blow and choosing your Rowan Ring melee weapon won't deal damage)  [RTR 19960221]
